output.rationale: The answer reaches the same conclusion as the reference: creatine monohydrate is safe long-term in healthy adults and does not damage the kidneys. It labels this as consensus with high confidence and treats the single case report as very low grade evidence, so it avoids false balance. Its numbers (up to 5 years, 3 to 25 g/day) are consistent with the reference's 5 years and 30 g/day. Citing 25 g/day rather than 30 g/day is a minor difference in the top of the range.
